method: Owner-approved save-only scope: current and recovered reports via actual production renderer/preload/controller, separate picker and Save, 30 repeated prepare/cancel exports, minimum 7-second cells. Full retains hooks/status/trace/heartbeat and exact-byte file oracles; Minimal has no live full-report oracle. Same 32 MiB combined sampled managed process gate, 8 MiB controlled binary gate and affected strict 4ms responsiveness gate. This does not pass or rerun the removed viewer/selection requirement. OS and heap sampling are observed costs, not a continuous managed/OS peak guarantee.

timingAttribution.method: Supplemental fixed-ring async callback/observer spans and recovered-only 500us V8 sampling; original workload retained, original failure not replaced. Profiler scheduling adds observer cost; CPU samples are approximate and callback/observer spans are wall time, not an OS scheduling trace.

memory.method: GetProcessMemoryInfo for two owned PIDs. OS process-lifetime peak commit includes native/crypto/libuv and renderer external pages; incremental commit is not continuous logical allocation accounting. Private commit sampled at requested 2ms cadence; actual scheduler cadence unguaranteed.
